sources.query: SELECT TRADING_PARTNER_NAME, TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID, TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT, BUDGET_IMPACT_IND, D_C_INDICATOR, AMOUNT, JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, RECORD_CATEGORY, GL_PERIOD, BALANCE_TYPE, TRADING_PARTNER_ID, PERIOD_NAME, EXCEPTION_CATEGORY, DOLLAR_AMOUNT, REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE, DACT_REPORT_IND, PIID, PARENT_AWARD_ID, FAIN, URI, DOC_NUM, DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE, AE_HEADER_ID, AE_LINE_NUM, ETL_PROC_WID, INTEGRATION_ID, CREATED_ON_DT, DELETE_FLG, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, W_INSERT_DT, W_UPDATE_DT, PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME, EVENT_ID, TP_OPDIV, TP_LEDGER_WID, GL_ACCOUNT_WID, MCAL_PERIOD_WID, LEDGER_WID, GL_JE_SOURCE_WID, GL_JE_CATEGORY_WID, POSTED_DATE, FUND_VALUE, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE, FED_NON_FED, TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE FROM W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_F

SELECT fs.TRADING_PARTNER_NAME, fs.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID, fs.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT, fs.BUDGET_IMPACT_IND, fs.D_C_INDICATOR, fs.AMOUNT, fs.JE_HEADER_ID, fs.JE_LINE_NUM, fs.RECORD_CATEGORY, fs.GL_PERIOD, fs.BALANCE_TYPE, fs.TRADING_PARTNER_ID, fs.PERIOD_NAME, fs.EXCEPTION_CATEGORY, fs.DOLLAR_AMOUNT, fs.REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE, fs.DACT_REPORT_IND, fs.PIID, fs.PARENT_AWARD_ID, fs.FAIN, fs.URI, fs.DOC_NUM, fs.DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE, fs.AE_HEADER_ID, fs.AE_LINE_NUM, fs.INTEGRATION_ID, fs.CREATED_ON_DT, 'N' AS DELETE_FLG, fs.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, fs.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, fs.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME, fs.EVENT_ID, (SELECT MIN(a.ROW_WID) FROM W_GL_ACCOUNT_D a WHERE a.INTEGRATION_ID = fs.CCID AND a.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = fs.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND a.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y') AS GL_ACCOUNT_WID, (SELECT MIN(p.ROW_WID) FROM W_MCAL_PERIOD_D p WHERE p.MCAL_PERIOD = fs.PERIOD_YEAR AND p.MCAL_YEAR = fs.PERIOD_NUM AND p.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = fs.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID) AS MCAL_PERIOD_WID, (SELECT MIN(l.ROW_WID) FROM W_LEDGER_D l WHERE l.INTEGRATION_ID = fs.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID AND l.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = fs.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID) AS LEDGER_WID, (SELECT MIN(js.ROW_WID) FROM W_GL_JE_SOURCES_D js WHERE js.INTEGRATION_ID = fs.JE_SOURCE) AS GL_JE_SOURCE_WID, (SELECT MIN(jc.ROW_WID) FROM W_GL_JE_CATEGORIES_D jc WHERE jc.INTEGRATION_ID = fs.JE_CATEGORY) AS GL_JE_CATEGORY_WID, fs.POSTED_DATE, fs.FUND_VALUE, fs.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, fs.AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE, fs.FED_NON_FED, fs.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE FROM W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS fs

_notes: BLOCKED: create_dataflow failed with ORA-00942 (table or view does not exist) resolving JDBC 1's query FROM W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_F. The fact table itself does not exist in DevContainer(518)'s Oracle schema -- this is an environment/data provisioning gap, not a test-case defect. See OKF/workflows/HHS_SIL_GTASActivityBalanceFact/hrd_mapping.md for the recorded status. Needs DB provisioning outside this pipeline's scope before this test case can build/run.

Confirmed via list_containers/list_engines/list_folders/list_data_sources against DevContainer(518): engineName=168_AN and folderName=Dataflow are valid. No registered data source named W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_F (fact table) or for any of the 5 dimension tables (W_GL_ACCOUNT_D, W_MCAL_PERIOD_D, W_LEDGER_D, W_GL_JE_SOURCES_D, W_GL_JE_CATEGORIES_D) exists in this container -- only W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS and FV_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES are registered, all pointing at the same Oracle connection/schema. JDBC 1's dataSourceName was corrected from W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_F to W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS (same connection, query still selects FROM W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_F) -- mirrors how JDBC 2 already references W_GL_ACCOUNT_D etc. directly by table name within its query, and how the sibling SDE test case references FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL/W_GTAS_INTRAHHS_D the same way, without a dedicated data source per table.
Checked list_dataflows on DevContainer(518): no name collision for 'HHS_SIL_GTASActivityBalanceFact_TestCase' -- unlike the SDE-layer sibling, which needed a _v2 suffix.

MCAL_PERIOD_WID join in JDBC 2 intentionally reproduces the deployed mapping's apparent PERIOD_YEAR/MCAL_PERIOD vs PERIOD_NUM/MCAL_YEAR naming swap as-is -- this is the rule under test, not a bug to fix in the test case.

JDBC 2's SELECT list may be missing ~15 passthrough fields that field_lineage in the compaction summary lists but the printed SQL override text does not show (summary appears truncated) -- suspected compaction-tool gap, not something to patch around here; flag for a tooling fix rather than silently adding guessed columns.

The 9-column composite unique key (JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, AE_HEADER_ID, AE_LINE_NUM, BALANCE_TYPE, RECORD_CATEGORY, GL_ACCOUNT_WID, LEDGER_WID, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID) is inferred from the fact's grain, mirroring the sibling SDE test case's approach -- prefer the real target table PK/unique constraint if it can be confirmed.
